question: In the assisted standing posture, does enabling the four CONDITIONAL coxa channels (joint_LFCoxa, joint_LHCoxa, joint_LMCoxa, joint_RMCoxa; H1) change how far a brief fore-aft thorax push displaces the body root, relative to the same push without coxa channels, with H1_FLIP as the specificity control?
not_an_admission_test: No coordinate status changes from any outcome.

sources.pulse_origin: malecns_backend/embodiment/m9b_external_perturbation.py and docs/TACTILE_DISTURBANCE_RECOVERY_V1.md (world force 1.024 native units, Thorax COM, zero torque, outgoing transitions 5000-5199, impulse 0.02048)
sources.c0_note: coxa-admission-v1 raw arms C0_1..3 (local, uncommitted); hashes from docs/evidence/coxa-admission-v1/run/report.json (sha 088a642c...)

disturbance.body: unique exact Thorax body, world frame, body COM, zero torque, via the kernel's external_force_by_transition
disturbance.declared_change: direction fore-aft (+/-x, anterior = +x per Step B) instead of the inherited lateral +y; magnitude, duration and point unchanged and never adjusted

arms.seed_mechanism: brain.rng = default_rng(seed) at attach, before the first neural transition

sets.N: Step C A_ON, no coxa channel
sets.C: + four CONDITIONAL channels H1 (hypothesis-labelled session path)

integrity.I2_common_rng_within_seed: identical per-tick uniforms and schedule within each seed
integrity.I3_reproduces_c0: N0_s equals coxa-admission C0_s over the whole run (qpos every sample; fired, uniforms, hair deliveries every tick)
integrity.I4_exact_force: every sample i records exactly the planned Thorax wrench of transition i-1 (zero torque, no other body, generalized applied force zero); _0 arms record no force
integrity.I5_channels_bounds: v3 inventories identical; N arms no hypothesis channel and constant coxa commands; C/X exactly the four channels with the declared hashes and label; |offset| <= 0.25 rad; other non-v3 commands equal the matching N arm
integrity.I6_prefixes: pushed arms equal their _0 arm through physics index 5000 (qpos, commands; fired for ticks at or before 500 ms); C/X equal the matching N arm until their first coxa command
integrity.I7_seeds_applied: tick-1 uniforms differ between seeds; every arm records its seed

pulse_precondition: metrics.response(N{F,B}_s, N0_s).resolved_perturbation in every seed and direction (peak orientation error > 0.25 deg or peak root deviation > 0.005 model mm from 500 ms); else INCONCLUSIVE_PULSE with no labels

measures.control: each pushed arm vs the _0 arm of the same set and seed
measures.D_primary: trapezoidal integral of ||root position(pushed) - root position(control)|| over stored states 5201..20000 (520.1-2000 ms), model mm * s
reported: metrics.response output (orientation peak/mean/integral, peak position/height/velocity errors, recovery status, support, tilt)
signed fore-aft root deviation along the push

labels.ratio: R_s = D(C{p}_s) / D(N{p}_s); flip ratio R'_s = D(X{p}_s) / D(N{p}_s); per push direction p in {F, B}

Q_SIGN.SIGN_SPECIFIC: R' fails Q_LOOP's own bar in Q_LOOP's direction in >= 2 of 3 seeds

labels.bar_note: 10 % is an engineering resolution fixed before any run; no noise estimate exists

consequence_declared_in_advance: LOOP_ATTENUATES + SIGN_SPECIFIC: first evidence that the conditional coxa loops contribute to postural resistance in this model (servo-assisted; not independent balance). SIGN_INDEPENDENT: the channels change the response but not through the reflex direction. NO_CONSISTENT_LOOP_EFFECT or LOOP_AMPLIFIES: recorded as is. No channel, weight, threshold, gain, magnitude or seed changes; no coordinate status changes; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +4 conditional.
interpretation_limits: Position-assisted posture; the loops only modulate servo setpoints; not independent balance.
One engineering pulse (magnitude from M9B), fore-aft direction declared; not a biological disturbance scale.
Three seeds that vary only stochastic sensory timing.
Only the four fore-aft CONDITIONAL coxa channels are added.
Root deviation is relative to a moving control, not absolute stability.
